evidence_set: Memory and attention went both ways: with oral CBD before intravenous THC, the delayed-recall impairment was lessened (Englund et al., 2013); with vaporised THC, prose recall was impaired to the same level and N-back working memory was impaired, with and without CBD (Morgan et al., 2018); in the 14-person vaporised study, a digit-symbol task was impaired only after THC alone while divided attention was more impaired with CBD (Arkell et al., 2019). Psychomotor and simulated driving: impairment with and without CBD in most studies; in one oral study, right-hand tapping was slower only with CBD, while THC alone slowed left-hand tapping in two of five sessions (Roser et al., 2009).
